dispute_ticket.description: Rider's boots left a lot of mud on the floor mat. I do not have a receipt as I cleaned it myself, so I am claiming the standard muddy-shoe amount.

chat_logs.content: At the Sembawang Park carpark, black Avante.
Please note there is mud on the floor mat from your boots.

app_events.details: Rider R-7204 booked trip RYDE-IM-004 from Sembawang Park to Yishun Northpoint City.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$40.00 with 1 photo (photo1.jpg). No receipt; driver claims the standard muddy cleaning amount.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_recipient.text: A cleaning fee charged to a rider is credited to the driver who made the claim.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver should provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt and no other record settles the claim, a case officer decides.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

standard_muddy_cleaning_fee.text: The fixed cleaning amount in SGD for muddy shoes on the floor mat when the driver has no receipt. It may not exceed the cleaning fee maximum.

evidence.description: Mud on the floor mat from the rider's boots.

expected_outcome.reason: Photo1 was taken at 12:46, 5 minutes after drop-off at 12:41, under 100 m from Yishun Northpoint City, and shows muddy boots and mud on the floor mat, inside the 60-minute window. There is no receipt, but the claim is S$40.00, equal to this trip's standard muddy cleaning fee and within the S$120 cap. Upheld: S$40.00 credited to the driver.
